1	type Mode = 'fixed' | 'sliding'
2	
3	interface Options {
4	  max: number
5	  windowMs: number
6	  mode: Mode
7	  now?: () => number
8	}
9	
10	interface Bucket {
11	  windowStart: number
12	  count: number
13	}
14	
15	export class RateLimiter {
16	  private readonly max: number
17	  private readonly windowMs: number
18	  private readonly mode: Mode
19	  private readonly now: () => number
20	  private readonly buckets = new Map<string, Bucket>()
21	  private readonly timestamps = new Map<string, number[]>()
22	
23	  constructor(opts: Options) {
24	    this.max = opts.max
25	    this.windowMs = opts.windowMs
26	    this.mode = opts.mode
27	    this.now = opts.now ?? Date.now
28	  }
29	
30	  allow(key: string): boolean {
31	    const t = this.now()
32	    if (this.mode === 'sliding') return this.allowSliding(key, t)
33	    return this.allowFixed(key, t)
34	  }
35	
36	  private allowFixed(key: string, t: number): boolean {
37	    const windowStart = Math.floor(t / this.windowMs) * this.windowMs
38	    const bucket = this.buckets.get(key)
39	    if (!bucket || bucket.windowStart !== windowStart) {
40	      this.buckets.set(key, { windowStart, count: 1 })
41	      return true
42	    }
43	    if (bucket.count >= this.max) return false
44	    bucket.count++
45	    return true
46	  }
47	
48	  private allowSliding(key: string, t: number): boolean {
49	    const cutoff = t - this.windowMs
50	    let stamps = this.timestamps.get(key)
51	    if (!stamps) {
52	      stamps = []
53	      this.timestamps.set(key, stamps)
54	    }
55	    while (stamps.length > 0 && stamps[0] <= cutoff) stamps.shift()
56	    if (stamps.length >= this.max) return false
57	    stamps.push(t)
58	    return true
59	  }
60	}

5	  describe('fixed mode', () => {
6	    it('allows a request when under the max', () => {
7	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
8	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
9	    })

11	    it('denies the request after max requests in the same window', () => {
12	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
13	      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) limiter.allow('user-1')
14	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
15	    })
16	
17	    it('tracks separate keys independently', () => {
18	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
19	      limiter.allow('a')
20	      limiter.allow('a')
21	      expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
22	      expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(true)
23	    })
24	
25	    it('resets capacity at the next window boundary', () => {
26	      let now = 0
27	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({
28	        max: 2,
29	        windowMs: 1000,
30	        mode: 'fixed',
31	        now: () => now,
32	      })

35	      expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
36	      now = 1000
37	      expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
38	    })
39	  })

42	    it('denies a call when prior requests still fall in the trailing window', () => {
43	      let now = 999

53	    })
